alternative_interpretations: This may depict a theatrical performance or illustration where the cage is symbolic props and the expression is stylized acting, not literal entrapment.
limitations: No textual labels or contextual setting confirm symbolic intent; the scene could be literal (e.g., an art installation) without metaphorical meaning.
